crm.senior_leads.add.title: Add a senior lead
crm.senior_leads.add.guidance: In Contacts, select **+ Add New**, enter the lead details, and save.

crm.senior_leads.milestones.title: Review lead milestones
crm.senior_leads.milestones.guidance: Review Initial Contact, Home Tour, biographical information, and document e-sign milestones. Use them to identify what still needs attention.

crm.senior_leads.intake.title: Complete senior intake
crm.senior_leads.intake.guidance: Click on the lead’s name. Review Biography, Medical, Care Plan (ADLs and health), and Documents. Enter intake details in the applicable tabs and save.

crm.senior_leads.documents.title: Prepare senior agreements
crm.senior_leads.documents.guidance: Select the lead’s name, open Documents, and add or prepare the applicable agreements. Confirm the required packet with your administrator if unclear.

crm.senior_leads.invite.title: Invite a senior lead
crm.senior_leads.invite.guidance: With an email on the selected lead, open the row’s three-dot menu and select **Onboard** to invite them to the Assistly portal.

crm.senior_leads.esign.title: Initiate senior e-sign
crm.senior_leads.esign.guidance: For a new senior lead using the signing workflow, review the documents attached to the lead before selecting **Initiate E-Sign** from the row menu; this sends the lead’s documents for signature. Skip this step for a resident already with the home before it adopted Assistly Care.

crm.senior_leads.move.title: Move a senior lead to Clinical
crm.senior_leads.move.guidance: From the selected lead’s row menu, choose **Move to Clinical** when the record is eligible. For residents already with the home before Assistly Care, use this path without e-sign.

crm.senior_leads.bulk.title: Send a bulk message
crm.senior_leads.bulk.guidance: In Contacts, use the select-all checkbox or select individual leads, then choose **Send Bulk Message**.

crm.senior_leads.history.title: Review campaign history
crm.senior_leads.history.guidance: Open the **Campaigns History** tab to view previous campaigns.

crm.referral_agents.add.title: Add a referral agent
crm.referral_agents.add.guidance: Select **+ Add New**, enter the referral agent details, and save.

crm.referral_agents.campaign.title: Manage referral campaigns
crm.referral_agents.campaign.guidance: Select recipients before sending a bulk message. Use campaign history to review prior campaigns where available.

crm.referral_agents.manage.title: Update a referral agent
crm.referral_agents.manage.guidance: Set the status to Contacted, Not Contacted, Follow Up Required, or Not Interested and save. Use the row’s three-dot menu to edit or delete an agent.

crm.care_leads.add.title: Add a care lead
crm.care_leads.add.guidance: Select **+ Add New**, enter the care lead details, and save.

crm.care_leads.documents.title: Manage care lead documents
crm.care_leads.documents.guidance: Select the care lead’s name to open their document management area. Add applicable documents; existing documents can be viewed, edited, or deleted by authorized users. Confirm which documents are required for this home.

crm.care_leads.menu.title: Review available care lead actions
crm.care_leads.menu.guidance: Open the row’s three-dot menu. Guide users only to actions shown for their role and record; verify each action before adding it to the flow.

crm.nurse_leads.add.title: Add a nurse lead
crm.nurse_leads.add.guidance: Select **+ Add New**, enter the nurse lead details, and save. Further nurse lead steps need verification.

clinical.seniors.verify.title: Verify the resident in Clinical
clinical.seniors.verify.guidance: Switch to List View and locate the resident. Select their name to open details, including the Face Sheet. Verify the intended resident record exists in Clinical after transfer.

clinical.seniors.menu.title: Find resident actions
clinical.seniors.menu.guidance: In List View, open the resident’s three-dot menu. Depending on access, look for Onboard, Add Medication, MedPass, Incident Report, or Initiate E-Sign for new documents.

clinical.seniors.medications.title: Manage medication records
clinical.seniors.medications.guidance: Authorized staff can add, edit, or delete medication records, or upload a list for bulk extraction. Qualified staff should verify extracted entries before they are used for care. Gia explains navigation and does not change records or give clinical advice.

clinical.care_team.details.title: Review a care team member
clinical.care_team.details.guidance: Select the member’s name to open their record and Face Sheet. The row menu does not include Onboard per the supplied notes; verify other actions separately.

clinical.nurses.details.title: Review a nurse record
clinical.nurses.details.guidance: Select the nurse’s name to open their record and Face Sheet. The row menu does not include Onboard per the supplied notes; verify other actions separately.
